, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly decided to “normalize” Man’s Search for Happiness to a 2019 official YouTube/Church upload as the earliest release, instead of using the film’s actual original release date (1964, with a 1986 remake). This methodological error contradicts authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia/IMDb indicating 1964) and skewed the comparison against Tell It to the Bees (premiered 2018), leading toward the wrong conclusion about which film was released earlier.
